versions.note: First pass at Penny: sign in, home, activity, sending money, budgets and settings.

Budgets became Insights. Home gets the indigo balance card and an insight banner, Send money says "Review transfer", Settings adds Weekly insights, and the Components sheet adds an Accent button with rounder corners.
